items.title: Yale’s Sonnenfeld: Nvidia is a ‘detriment’ to US industrial might — not a champion
items.summary: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns that what the market cheered Monday, Jensen Huang's White House–backed return as Nvidia's CEO and board member, could prove a giant mistake, exposing the directors to "historic" personal liability from a growing pile of lawsuits and raising the question of whether the country is celebrating a company that has helped put advanced chips in its adversaries' hands.

items.title: Jensen Huang still thinks a succession plan creates unnecessary hierarchy
items.summary: It's a remarkable stance for a company that spent the last two weeks finding out what happens without its founder.

items.title: In all-hands meeting, Jensen Huang thanks White House and says he’s in therapy
items.summary: The Nvidia founder apologized to his staff on Tuesday and said he was grateful for a second chance to lead the company.

items.title: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
items.summary: As millions embrace personal AI assistants, a new benchmark reveals that even the most advanced AI models struggle to complete everyday tasks reliably and safely without introducing potential new problems.

items.title: Walmart teams up with Meta to bring Black Friday deals to AI agent Muse
items.summary: Walmart now lets customers shop Black Friday deals through Muse, Meta’s AI agent.

items.title: Maple raises $5.3M to build AI products that protect your data, even from itself
items.summary: The startup's encrypted AI architecture is designed to prevent even the company itself from accessing users' private data.

items.title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price, a worrying sign for AI startups
items.summary: Anthropic’s post-IPO slump could put pressure on AI startup valuations.

items.title: UK warns AI-driven cyberattacks are exposing years of weak security
items.summary: The British cyber agency says that "building strong foundations has never mattered more" as AI hacking tools rely on exploiting simple security flaws.

items.title: Meta brings its Muse AI assistant directly into Instagram DMs
items.summary: The new integration gets rid of the need for users to toggle between Instagram and the Muse app when they want to interact with the AI agent.

items.title: Tidal to ban and remove millions of AI-generated tracks as AI slop inundates music streaming
items.summary: The company said it will still accept songs that were made with AI assistance, but not fully generated.

items.title: Why a Crusoe investor is betting on solar and batteries to power future AI data centers
items.summary: Next-generation data centers will need tens of gigawatts of power every year. One of Crusoe's investors thinks solar and energy storage are the obvious choice.

items.title: Pinterest will now let parents limit the AI-generated content their teens see
items.summary: While other social platforms have focused on restricting teens' access to AI chatbots, Pinterest is addressing the AI content filling their feeds.

items.title: Amazon’s Decart acquisition is a bet on using software to narrow the silicon gap with Nvidia
items.summary: Amazon’s decision to acquire Decart for a reported $7.5 billion is part of its efforts to improve the efficiency of its Trainium chips.

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
items.summary: As AI-generated code piles up, Anthropic's new developer tools aim to eliminate another bottleneck by letting agents handle routine approvals.

items.title: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios
items.summary: Think you know where the market is headed? A startup called Supertake lets you put money behind your ideas without having to pick the stocks yourself.

items.title: Elon Musk and others rejoice as Jensen Huang is reinstated at Nvidia amid scandal
items.summary: "The mistake has been corrected," Elon Musk chimed in.

items.title: Megaspeed, the company at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, appears headed for a US blacklist
items.summary: Megaspeed, which was previously led by Alice Huang, would be barred from doing business with U.S. companies unless those companies attained a special license from the federal government.

items.title: Nvidia employees greet Jensen Huang like a hero as he returns to company’s HQ
items.summary: "I'm going to be a better CEO the second time around," Huang told employees.

items.title: Google Search’s AI Mode can now tap into Drive and Wallet for more personalized responses
items.summary: By bringing Personal Intelligence in AI Mode to Drive, Wallet, and the Gemini app, Google is leveraging the wealth of user data that's already within its ecosystem

items.title: Jensen Huang scheduled to testify next week in Senate following reinstatement as Nvidia CEO
items.summary: The public hearing follows bipartisan calls for Huang to testify about the affair with the suspected Chinese spy.
